The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D3200' clearly visible on the top right.
The lens has 'Nikon DX' and 'AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR' printed on the barrel.
The box is labeled 'Nikon D3200 18-55 VR II Kit' with 'D3200' and 'AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II' printed on the front.
The camera body appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear visible.

Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED' are overlaid on both photos.
